service.description: Validates DTE generation consistency by cloning an order associated with a FiscalTaxDocument and regenerating its DTE for comparison with the original. Returns validation results including any discrepancies found between the original and regenerated DTE.

parameter.name: fiscalTaxDocumentId
parameter.description: The original FiscalTaxDocument ID to validate

parameter.name: validationPassed
parameter.description: True if no discrepancies found between original and regenerated DTE

parameter.name: discrepancies
parameter.description: List of differences found between original and regenerated DTE

parameter.name: clonedOrderId
parameter.description: ID of the cloned order created for validation

parameter.name: generationError
parameter.description: Any error that occurred during DTE generation

service.description: Validates DTE generation consistency for all FiscalTaxDocuments within a specified date range. For each document, clones the associated order and regenerates the DTE to compare with the original. Returns a list of fiscalTaxDocumentIds that failed validation along with their discrepancy details.

parameter.name: fromDate
parameter.description: Start date for the validation range (inclusive)

parameter.name: thruDate
parameter.description: End date for the validation range (inclusive)

parameter.name: fiscalTaxDocumentTypeEnumId
parameter.description: Optional filter by document type (e.g., Ftdt-33 for invoices)

parameter.name: failedCount
parameter.description: Number of documents that failed validation

parameter.name: validationResults
parameter.description: List of validation results for failed documents. Each entry contains: - fiscalTaxDocumentId: The document ID - fiscalTaxDocumentNumber: The document folio - date: The document issue date - validationPassed: Boolean (always false for this list) - discrepancies: List of differences found - generationError: Any error during generation - clonedOrderId: ID of the cloned order
